title: Rain&Thunder Countdown
description: Simple yet fully customizable and togglable rain and thunder countdown
body:
FOR THE MOD TO WORK YOU NEED TO WAIT FOR RAIN!!! THEN EVERYTHING WILL WORK(mod needs to hook up the rain lines) DO NOT WORRY

Thunder Countdown

![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/C3bdiZI9/images/fcd19473b846f2c4506ada9d29213a34580df8fa.png)

Ever wondered how long until it starts raining — or when that thunderstorm will finally end? Thunder Countdown adds a clean, lightweight HUD overlay that shows you exactly that, in real time.

Features

Rain countdown — shows how long until the next rain starts when the weather is clear
Rain timer — shows how long until the rain stops while it's raining
Thunder timer — shows how long until the thunderstorm ends while it's active
Reads real Minecraft weather data directly — no fake timers, no guessing
Fully customizable via Mod Menu + Cloth Config:

Toggle rain and thunder timers independently
Choose a custom color for each timer state (clear / raining / thundering)


Full English and Russian localization — the HUD and settings automatically follow your in-game language


How it works
The mod reads the internal weather timers straight from the Minecraft server every second and sends them to the client. Nothing is simulated — what you see is exactly what Minecraft has scheduled.

FOR THE MOD TO WORK YOU NEED TO WAIT FOR RAIN!!! THEN EVERYTHING WILL WORK(mod needs to hook up the rain lines) DO NOT WORRY

Note on thunder: Minecraft does not plan thunderstorms in advance. The thunder timer is only shown while a thunderstorm is already active. During regular rain, the thunder indicator shows ? because the game hasn't decided yet.


Dependencies
Mod Required: Fabric API✅ Required: Cloth Config✅ Required: Mod Menu✅ 

Compatibility

Minecraft 26.1.x
Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.2
Java 25+
